en.headline: HKMAO calls for stronger systems to bring in competent patriotic governance talent
en.dek: The Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office said in a People’s Daily article that Hong Kong should improve training, selection, appointment and management to build a governing team with integrity and competence.
body: The theoretical study group of the State Council’s Hong Kong and Macau Affairs Office published a commentary in the People’s Daily on Monday urging Hong Kong to enhance its systems for nurturing and managing governance talent.

The article stressed that national security must remain the foundation for the city’s development and called for greater attention to security in finance, shipping, trade and the protection of overseas interests.

It said implementing the principle of patriots governing Hong Kong is key to long-term prosperity and stability, and that the city should select people of both ability and political integrity for the governing team.
The commentary was published four days after the independent committee released its report on last year’s deadly Tai Po fire, which led to the resignation of the housing chief.

zh.headline: 港澳辦文章促完善機制吸納德才兼備管治人才
zh.dek: 國務院港澳辦理論學習組在《人民日報》發表文章，指香港應完善培養、選拔、任用和管理機制，建設有德有才的管治隊伍。
body: 國務院港澳事務辦公室理論學習組周一在《人民日報》發表評論文章，呼籲香港完善培養和管理管治人才的制度。
文章強調國家安全是城市發展的基礎，並要求在金融、航運、貿易及海外利益保護等領域更加重視安全。
文章指出，落實「愛國者治港」原則是長期繁榮穩定的關鍵，應按照德才兼備的標準選賢任能，把優秀人才吸納到管治團隊。
該評論於獨立調查委員會公布去年大埔火災報告後四日發表，房屋局局長其後辭職以承擔政治責任。
